ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/yellowish) across distal regions and 35% low-intensity pixels (dark gray/black) centered around the notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity blobs occupy the outer two-thirds of both lobes; a central low-intensity 'V' shaped region extends from the notch; multiple discrete high-intensity micro-spots (pixels) are scattered within the dark central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with moderate to high-frequency variations; peak-to-valley amplitude increases from the notch toward the distal tips, ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge contour follows a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/brown) pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical and diagonal high-intensity linear pixel streaks (rake marks/scratches) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustations on both lobe tips; global yellowish-tan pixel tinting observed over high-intensity white regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical dark pigmentation wedge centered on the median notch.
